title: cissus curvipoda
intro: Cissus curvipoda, commonly known as the "Bone Fix" or "Veldt Grape", is a plant species in the Vitaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to support joint health and bone density. The health benefits of Cissus curvipoda include reducing inflammation and pain associated with arthritis and other musculoskeletal conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, that have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
